bundle.text:
# Eight stable component IDs. Saved profile row overrides take precedence.
# The four enhanced-preset mode rows and discovery start enabled; the
# Compatibility fallback, data capture and the TUI integration are opt-in.
# Minimal publishes no routing section, so its row carries only the shell keys.
# Legacy component modules (shell, file, ptc, hide-official, background) remain
# exported but are no longer inserted here: a saved override for one of those
# old specifiers still loads its legacy module, it just cannot match a new row.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-ops-linux-mode-minimal
      name: dsh-ops-linux/mode-minimal
      config:
        promptPolicy: true
        publishBashTool: true
    - id: dsh-ops-linux-mode-standard
      name: dsh-ops-linux/mode-standard
      config:
        promptPolicy: true
        required: false
    - id: dsh-ops-linux-mode-ptc
      name: dsh-ops-linux/mode-ptc
      config:
        required: false
        alwaysLoaded: []
    - id: dsh-ops-linux-mode-cordis
      name: dsh-ops-linux/mode-cordis
      config:
        promptPolicy: true
        required: false
    - id: dsh-ops-linux-discovery
      name: dsh-ops-linux/discovery
      config:
        enabled: true
        maxResults: 3
        alwaysLoaded: []
        required: false
        denyCredentialReads: true
    - id: dsh-ops-linux-compat
      name: dsh-ops-linux/compat
      disabled: true
    - id: dsh-ops-linux-panel
      name: dsh-ops-linux/panel
      disabled: true
      config:
        # Row enablement starts capture; explicit legacy capture:false stays inert.
        capture: true
        textLimit: 2000
        maxSessionBytes: 8388608
    - id: dsh-ops-linux-tui
      name: dsh-ops-linux/tui
      disabled: true
      config:
        maxSessions: 32
        maxActive: 128
        recentLimit: 8

readme.text: 中文 | English

> **This is `dsh-ops-linux`, a self-maintained branch of [T-Auto/dsh-ops](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops)** targeting Linux/ARM64 (Android) and DSH 0.2.2. Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add <tarball or this checkout>`. Changes and build steps: [PORT.en.md](PORT.en.md).

以提高token效率为目的，提供新增的ops系列工具并隐藏部分官方工具为方案的插件，低改动面，低侵入性，与其他插件广泛兼容。

- （仅 Windows）启用与 dsh 原生 bash 行为一致的 ops_bash；启用模式行时用它替换官方 pwsh，兼容模式则保留官方工具
- 四个预设模式行分别增强内置 Minimal/Standard/PTC/Cordis preset：Standard 与 Cordis 替换官方 read/glob/grep，PTC 提供类型化 SDK，Minimal 只替换 Windows shell；discovery 行启用时其会话始终获得动态加载入口；兼容模式（默认关闭）可保留全部官方工具
- 启用 DSH 预留的 `tools_addition` 动态工具加载，并提供渐进式纰漏的工具，作为高级功能（如pdf、word读取、超多文件批量修改）的加载平台，大大减少常见特定场景的token消耗量，且不会导致系统提示词膨胀
- 为 Native 模式提供返回紧凑、带行号和更好错误回馈的工具以遏制报错循环，减少调用轮次
- 为 PTC 模式提供一些返回结构化 JSON 值的工具以降低 ai 在 ptc 模式下编写 TypeScript 代码的token总量和心智负担
- PTC SDK 目录包含 18 个 API：15 个文件/文档工具，加批处理、结果引用和加载器。

左：deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017在各harness的跑分与开销
右：ops在自用benchmark上取得的的成绩。完整benchmark将随后续更新发布
dsh-ops团队将致力于持续优化dsh的token效率，以更低的成本更好地完成同样的任务

在目标 DSH 应用的插件市场中输入 npm 包名 **`dsh-ops`**，选择自定义地址，输入 `https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/repository/npm/`，安装后选择启用。目前不推荐用npmmirror安装，有bug。

当然，如果你确定可以连接 npm 官方源那就选择官方源，如果你不确定那就按教程操作。

```console
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile desktop
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile web
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile tui
```

必须显式选择目标 profile；`tui` 映射到 **dsh-TUI 产品的 `dsh-tui` profile**，不是旧的 `tui` 目录。请先初始化目标应用。该入口委托官方 DSH CLI 安装，不另写一套 profile 锁与回滚逻辑。

桌面端必须使用桌面应用自带的 CLI；默认探测 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`。安装在其它位置时加 `--dsh-cli "<安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"`。Web/TUI 需要可用的 DSH CLI，可同样显式指定。

安装或卸载时可加 `--dry-run` 预演。它按指定路径或 `PATH`（Windows 同时使用 `PATHEXT`）解析 CLI，检查文件、POSIX 执行权限及通过 Node 启动的入口文件，并在预演时同样拒绝不安全的 Windows 命令脚本路径；检查失败返回非零。预演只打印计划，不启动 CLI、不修改 profile。成功表示这些静态检查已通过，不保证所选程序的身份、版本、profile 兼容性或后续安装结果。

也可以直接使用官方命令：

```console
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ops
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add dsh-ops
"<桌面安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ops
```

普通 DSH CLI 不能管理保留的 `desktop` profile；不要把它与桌面自带入口混淆。

宿主兼容范围明确声明为 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2**。
组件图标导出、profile 刷新及配置/schema 检查见
[宿主兼容范围与展示元数据](docs/使用指南.md#宿主兼容范围与展示元数据)。

重新运行相同的 `npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile ...`，或用官方 CLI `add dsh-ops@latest`。按应用提示重载；替换已加载代码时重启应用。

```console
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest status --profile desktop
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest uninstall --profile desktop
```

把 `desktop` 换成 `web` 或 `tui` 即可。也可在市场卸载，或执行官方 `dsh plugin --profile ... remove dsh-ops`。插件依赖（含 Windows bash 可选载荷）随 profile 管理；单独 provision 的 Bash 用 `dsh-ops bash-runtime remove --yes` 移除，不误删系统 shell、其它 profile 的副本或包管理器共享缓存。

旧版显式 provision 的 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-ops/` 文件（provision 的 shell，以及早期版本可 provision 的 FastCtx 运行时）需单独清理：`npx --yes dsh-ops@latest uninstall --yes`。已移除的后台组件留下的 `~/.fastctx/` 状态默认不删；需要时显式加 `--purge-fastctx`。

组件 bundle 现为八行：`mode-minimal`、`mode-standard`、`mode-ptc`、`mode-cordis`、`discovery`、`compat`、`panel`、`tui`。旧的 `shell`、`file`、`ptc`、`hide-official` 行已移除，请删除为它们保存的 profile 覆盖，并按需重设模式开关。

原 `dsh-ops/background` 组件（FastCtx 后台任务）已移除。仍保留该行的 profile 照常加载：该行不发布任何工具，只记录一条警告，可直接删除。

readme.text: 在 dsh-TUI 中启用 `dsh-ops/tui` 行并重启，即可添加 OPS 侧栏；不抢焦点，不执行额外工具调用。没有 `tuiPanels` 的宿主仅让该可选行等待，不影响其它组件。见 [侧栏说明](docs/tui-panel.zh.md)。 聚焦后可用 `f` 筛选、`n`/`p` 本地翻页、`a` 确认跨会话提醒；只浏览有界保留元数据，不拉取结果分页。

> **This is `dsh-ops-linux`, a self-maintained branch of [T-Auto/dsh-ops](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops)** targeting Linux/ARM64 (Android) and DSH 0.2.2. Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add <tarball or this checkout>`. Changes and build steps: [PORT.en.md](PORT.en.md).

OPS adds bounded file and document tools to DSH. Native mode returns compact, line-numbered text;
PTC code receives typed Outcome values from the same one-shot Rust worker. Host integration is
strict TypeScript, compiled to the existing JavaScript package paths.

Supported: Windows x64, Linux x64, and macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon or Intel
(`darwin-arm64`, `darwin-x64`). See [macOS](docs/macos.md).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Version **0.4.4** repairs Linux and macOS runtime packaging from npm 0.4.3. Use 0.4.4 or
> newer on those platforms. The preset-mode component roster is unchanged; see the
> [changelog](docs/CHANGELOG.md).

- The default profile enables the four preset-mode rows: Standard and Cordis publish the resident
  OPS file tools, PTC publishes its typed SDK, and Minimal replaces only the Windows shell;
  its sessions receive the `ops_discover_tools` entry whenever the discovery row is enabled. A mode row replaces the official
  Windows shell with `ops_bash`. Advanced tools activate in the owning agent's next provider request.
- The PTC SDK catalogue has 18 APIs: 15 file/document tools, batch, result references and its loader.
  Only the configured resident or selected APIs are exposed. Native and PTC use separate outputs.
- Discover bounded CSV/TSV, DOCX main-body paragraphs and a restricted PDF text layer. Binary DOC,
  OCR, general PDF rendering, web search and HTML crawling are not implemented. Read the
  [document-format limits](docs/native-kernel.md) before choosing a reader.
- Eight independently toggled rows: the four mode rows and discovery start on; Compatibility,
  panel and TUI start off. An enabled mode row hides the official tools it replaces (read/glob/grep
  plus the Windows pwsh); Compatibility mode keeps the official tools visible. Saved overrides for
  the removed `shell`/`fi

OPS publishes its own scoped tools and optional routing guidance; it does not rewrite the shared
tool registry. Permissions and cancellation are checked per call. Windows restricted Bash retains
its documented partial enforcement and runtime-compatibility limits.

Historical token-saving claims are not evidence that this candidate meets its release gates.
The name “ops” means general operations, not an operations/SRE product.

In the target DSH application's plugin marketplace, enter the npm package name **`dsh-ops`**, choose a custom registry and enter `https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/repository/npm/`, install, then enable it. Installing through npmmirror is currently not recommended — it has bugs.

Of course, if you are sure you can reach the official npm registry, pick the official registry; if you are not sure, follow the steps above.

```console
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile desktop
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile web
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile tui
```

An explicit target profile is required. `tui` maps to the **dsh-TUI product's `dsh-tui` profile**, not the old `tui` directory. Initialize the target application first. This entry point delegates installation to the official DSH CLI rather than implementing a separate profile lock and rollback logic.

Desktop must use the CLI bundled with the desktop application; the default auto-detected path is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`. For another installation location, add `--dsh-cli "<installation>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"`. Web/TUI require an available DSH CLI, which can also be specified explicitly.

Add `--dry-run` to an install or uninstall command to preview it. The preview resolves the CLI from its path or `PATH` (`PATHEXT` on Windows), checks the file, POSIX execute permission and any Node CLI entry point, and applies the same Windows command-script path checks as execution. A failed check returns a nonzero exit code. The preview prints the plan without starting the CLI or changing the profile. Success covers these static checks; it does not establish the program's identity, version, profile compatibility or eventual installation result.

You can also use the official commands directly:

```console
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ops
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add dsh-ops
"<desktop installation>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ops
```

A regular DSH CLI cannot manage the reserved `desktop` profile; do not confuse it with the desktop app's own entry point.

Host compatibility is declared for DSH **0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2**. See
[host versions and display metadata](docs/usage.md#host-compatibility-and-display-metadata)
for component icon exports, profile refresh and config/schema checks.

Re-run the same `npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile ...`, or use the official CLI `add dsh-ops@latest`. Reload when the app asks; restart the app when replacing code that is already loaded.

```console
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest status --profile desktop
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest uninstall --profile desktop
```

Replace `desktop` with `web` or `tui` as needed. You can also uninstall from the marketplace, or run the official `dsh plugin --profile ... remove dsh-ops`. Profile uninstall removes plugin dependency references, including the optional Windows Bash payload. Remove separately provisioned Bash with `dsh-ops bash-runtime remove --yes`; this does not delete the system shell, copies in other profiles, or the package manager's shared cache.

Old files explicitly provisioned by earlier versions under `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-ops/` (provisioned shells, and the FastCtx runtime earlier versions could provision) need separate cleanup: `npx --yes dsh-ops@latest uninstall --yes`. The `~/.fastctx/` state left by the removed background component is not deleted by default; add `--purge-fastctx` when needed.

The former `dsh-ops/background` component (FastCtx background jobs) has been removed. A profile that still has its row keeps loading: the row publishes nothing and logs one warning, and can be deleted.

Enable the `dsh-ops/tui` row in dsh-TUI and restart to add the OPS sidebar without stealing focus or executing tools. Without `tuiPanels`, only that optional row stays pending. See [Sidebar guide](docs/tui-panel.md). While focused, use `f` to filter, `n`/`p` for local pages and `a` to acknowledge all-session alerts; only bounded retained metadata is browsed, never fetched result pages.
